commands.abstract: Describe the commands, their flags, their --json data and the error codes.
commands.name: silta schema

commands.abstract: List workspaces; ask in chat before editing configuration.
commands.name: silta ws ls

commands.abstract: Print the current workspace YAML without editing it.
commands.name: silta ws show

commands.abstract: Initialize or scan repos; select with ws use; configuration editing is human-only.
commands.name: silta init

commands.abstract: Fetch a repo, or all registered repos in the workspace, without prompting.
commands.name: silta repo fetch

commands.abstract: Add a proposal; --start claims work requested by the human.
commands.name: silta task add

commands.abstract: List workspace tasks, including your own proposals.
commands.name: silta task ls

commands.abstract: Read a task's current bodies, claim and optional event timeline.
commands.name: silta task show

commands.abstract: Claim a todo task for this exact actor and session.
commands.name: silta task start

commands.abstract: Submit doing work for review and refresh its claim.
commands.name: silta task submit

commands.abstract: Complete a task with its result and optional app commit.
commands.name: silta task done

commands.abstract: Drop an open task and record why.
commands.name: silta task drop

commands.abstract: Store a plan revision or tick a top-level checkbox.
commands.name: silta task plan

commands.abstract: Import Markdown steps; preview or safely remove the source.
commands.name: silta task from-plan
